messages:
incident-bot: CRITICAL ALERT • Canary health degrading for service=redwood-inference/inference-api • canary=canary-v2 • metric=5xx_rate • started=3245678901

deploy-bot: snapshot: 1m error rate=5.9% (baseline 0.15%), p95 latency jumped 1.7s→2.9s, pod restarts=2 in last 5m

sam (oncall): acked — looking now, paging @anya for handoff if customers impacted

maria (sre): seeing OOMs from model-worker on canary hosts. KV-cache eviction rates spiked, memory pressure consistent with new quantization change in v2

lee (deploy): rolling canary at 25% traffic. Recommend immediate stop of canary traffic and manual rollback to stable v1. If we keep routing, we'll risk session-level failures.

sam (oncall): plan: 1) flip feature flag to 0% 2) drain canary pods 3) kubectl rollback to v1 4) smoke test /predict endpoints 5) monitor 5xx and latency for 15m

anya (prod-eng): confirming customer-facing impact: looked at traces for last 10m — a handful of requests to public /v1/generate returned 503s, mostly from eu-west. Opening support ticket template for customers impacted: summary + mitigation + ETA.

maria (sre): how to flip quickly: feature-flag svc has API. example:

curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/inference_canary" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"percent":0}'

please run from bastion; I'll watch metrics.

lee (deploy): rolling action: kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=redwood/inference-api:v1 --record
if image set not ideal, use: kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=4

sam (oncall): executed flag flip (confirmed via flags UI). traffic to canary dropped to 0% at 3245678920 :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary traffic metric: canary_v2_traffic_pct=0.0 at 3245678921

maria (sre): starting drain of canary pods and issuing pod eviction on canary node group. watching for termination gracefully. please avoid new deploys.

lee (deploy): initiating rollback now. command run at 3245678935.

paul (support): prepping customer comms. Which customers saw errors? anya: can you share list + recommended phrasing for support ticket?

anya (prod-eng): sent list to #support-private (customers: acme-inc, pathos-io, learnly). Suggested message: "We observed elevated error rates impacting model inference after a canary deploy. We rolled back and are monitoring — ETA for stability 15m. Contact SRE if you still see 503s."

maria (sre): smoke tests executing:
POST /v1/predict {"prompt":"hello"} -> 200 OK
head /health -> OK

sam (oncall): monitoring dashboards: 5xx now trending down from 5.9% → 0.4% over 2m. p95 latency back near baseline.

maria (sre): verification checklist: 
- no OOM logs in model-worker for last 5m
- KV-cache evictions back to baseline
- pod restarts = 0 in last 5m
- smoke tests pass from eu and us regions

lee (deploy): confirmed rollout undo succeeded; current image tag = v1. stable replica count = 18

paul (support): posting incident note to affected accounts, linking rollback summary and monitoring dashboard.

sam (oncall): handing off to maria for 30m watch. if any regression, escalate to deploy. @maria — you take lead.

maria (sre): taking watch. creating follow-up ticket INF-5234 with root-cause investigation: hypothesis = new quantized operator in v2 causing memory spike under long sequences. will add logs and heap dumps.

anya (prod-eng): schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:30 PT, invitees: eng-runtime, eng-ml, sres, support.

sam (oncall): final notes: mitigation executed (flag flip + rollback). customer impact limited but non-zero. next up: RCA, test coverage for quantized operator memory, and canary throttling safeguards. closing thread unless anyone needs more. :white_check_mark:

maria (sre): thanks — I'm keeping watch and will ping if anything resurfaces.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED • canary_v2 traffic=0% • status=rolling-back • resolved_at=3245678965
